label: The pointer adds no step to the external install path; it changes only what the agent reads on a code query. Link mode asks four questions, prints five steps, and always links .skilled; copy mode exports .skilled and applies overlays. The pointer travels inside .skilled, so a linked project sees it after git pull and a copied project after a re-pin.

Absent is the default external state, and it is a clean no-op: the user reads one conditional sentence and does nothing, while the agent keeps the existing exact-text, known-path and concept-search tree. No install prompt, error or new command appears.

Half-installed has one diagnostic and a four-rung repair ladder: sweet-search status prints the failing rung and one Next step line, covering skipped postinstall scripts, missing models, an unready index and a failed server. No Skilled command participates.

Stale splits into two shapes: edits since the index self-heal after a first index exists, while an index built by an older sweet-search is never patched and needs one explicit sweet-search index --full. The daemon never builds the first index.

The Node-below-22 branch is unreachable in a repo that met Skilled's Node 24 prerequisite, so the pointer never needs to handle it. Native Windows without WSL2 remains the real unsupported state: sweet-search is first-class only on macOS, Linux and WSL2, while Git Bash can still satisfy Skilled's POSIX-shell requirement.

sweet-search init --agents writes a marker-delimited guide into AGENTS.md whose search policy conflicts with Skilled's widen-the-pattern rule; in link-instruction mode AGENTS.md points at the checkout's copy, so the append can write through to the shared checkout and affect every linked project. The pointer must never run init, and link-mode users should choose embed or accept the collision.
The optional pointer must not add a setup step, a detection script or a blocking dependency; every failure state must fall back to the existing code-search tree without an error.
Skilled's Node 24 prerequisite dominates sweet-search's Node 22 floor, so Node below 22 cannot occur in the external-repo population.
